placeholders.settingsBody: Application settings will appear here when the settings registry is available on this screen.

settings.intro: Channel and template configuration. Every change requires a reason and is written to the change log.
settings.forbiddenBody: The email channel and other system settings are available to administrators.

email.title: Email channel (Microsoft 365)
email.subtitle: Outbound notifications through the existing SMTP/O365 setup, internal users only.
email.smtpRequired: SMTP and the email addon must be enabled (install wizard or SMTP settings) before delivery.
email.deliveryHint: SMTP and the email addon are on. The channel sends mail only to internal @epbih.ba addresses while internal-only is on.
email.channelEnabledHint: Turns on the email channel next to the in-app inbox. Nothing is sent if SMTP or the email addon is off.
email.templatesEnabledHint: Use the edited subject/body templates. When off, built-in templates are used.
email.internalOnlyHint: Blocks delivery outside @epbih.ba. The allow-list is ignored while this is on.
email.subject: Subject
email.templateInvalid: Each template needs text and only allow-listed placeholders.
email.readOnly: You can view these settings but cannot change them.

errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.notFound: The requested record was not found.
errors.conflict: The record changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
errors.validation: The data is not valid. Check the input and try again.
errors.setupRequired: Installation has not been completed yet.
errors.readOnly: The system is in read-only mode.
errors.server: The server returned an error. Please try again.
errors.network: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.

dashboard.intro: Operational overview of the tickets you can access.
dashboard.emptyBody: Once the first ticket is created, counters and recent activity appear here.
dashboard.recentHint: Most recently created tickets you can access.
dashboard.recentEmptyBody: Tickets appear here after they are created.
dashboard.hintUnassigned: waiting for an owner in the group
dashboard.hintUnrouted: coverage gap — a rule is needed

services.title: Services
services.intro: Service catalogue and form readiness for ticket creation.
services.catalogHint: A service can accept tickets only when it has an active form version.
services.emptyBody: The service catalogue is empty. Services are created through service onboarding.

directory.usersEmptyBody: No user is mapped to an organizational unit.
directory.unitsIntro: OU hierarchy used for routing and visibility.
directory.unitsEmptyBody: The OU tree is empty. At least one unit is created during installation.

install.title: Initial setup
install.heading: SuperAdmin account
install.body: The first step creates a local SuperAdmin account. The password is stored only as a hash. Break-glass sign-in remains available after Entra AD is selected later.
install.createdBody: This account is local-only and remains available for break-glass sign-in. Later wizard steps continue after this one.
install.passwordMismatch: Password and confirmation do not match.
install.errorInvalid: SuperAdmin details are invalid. Check the email, display name, and password (at least 12 characters).
install.errorDuplicate: The initial SuperAdmin already exists or the email is already in use.
install.errorGeneric: The SuperAdmin account cannot be saved right now.

loginProvider.heading: Sign-in method
loginProvider.body: Select exactly one authentication provider. SuperAdmin remains a local break-glass account when Entra AD is selected.
loginProvider.localHint: Sign-in stays on local accounts. AD/Entra fields are not required.
loginProvider.entraHint: Enter Entra tenant and client identifiers or LDAPS bind details. Role mapping stays in Settings.
loginProvider.configured: Already saved. Leave empty to keep the current value.
loginProvider.breakGlass: The local SuperAdmin remains available for break-glass sign-in.
loginProvider.errorIncomplete: For Entra AD enter tenant and client, or complete LDAPS bind details.
loginProvider.errorInvalid: The sign-in configuration is invalid or incomplete.
loginProvider.errorGeneric: The sign-in method cannot be saved right now.

smtp.heading: SMTP
smtp.body: Enable SMTP for outbound email or leave it off. Off forcibly disables the email addon.
smtp.offHint: SMTP fields are not required. The email addon stays off and cannot be enabled while SMTP is off.
smtp.onHint: Enter SMTP host, port, TLS, username, password, and from address. The password is stored as a secret.
smtp.configured: A password is already saved. Leave empty to keep the current value.
smtp.errorIncomplete: When SMTP is on, enter host, port, username, password, and a valid from address.
smtp.errorInvalid: The SMTP configuration is invalid or incomplete.
smtp.errorGeneric: The SMTP configuration cannot be saved right now.

seed.heading: Initial data
seed.body: This creates the minimum needed for routing: one organizational unit, a fallback group, one service, and routing to that group. Demo tickets are not created.
seed.createdBody: Minimum data is ready. The origin OU and service resolve to the fallback group.
seed.errorGeneric: The initial data cannot be saved right now.

addons.heading: Add-ons
addons.body: Turn optional modules on or off. Core capabilities (ticketing, routing, inbox, RBAC, audit, in-app notifications, attachments) stay on. A disabled add-on can be enabled later in Settings.
addons.emailDisabledHint: Email stays off until SMTP is enabled.
addons.errorUnsupported: One or more add-ons are not in the catalog.
addons.errorGeneric: The add-ons cannot be saved right now.

sla.label: SLA
sla.description: SLA profiles, calendars, and overdue escalation.

email.label: Email
email.description: Outbound email channel. Requires SMTP to be enabled.

edge.label: Edge
edge.description: Browser extension for quick replies and remote requests.

teamsStub.label: Teams (stub)
teamsStub.description: Teams feature flag without actual message delivery.

csat.label: CSAT
csat.description: Satisfaction survey after a ticket is closed.

autoAssign.label: Auto-assign
autoAssign.description: Least Busy / Round Robin assignment inside a group.

approvals.label: Approvals
approvals.description: Approval flows on services that require them.

confidential.label: Confidential tickets
confidential.description: ACL and break-glass for confidential requests.

kbIntercept.label: KB intercept
kbIntercept.description: Show knowledge base articles before submitting a ticket.

timeTracking.label: Time tracking
timeTracking.description: Track time spent on a ticket.

bulkActions.label: Bulk actions
bulkActions.description: Bulk inbox actions, without bulk close.

complete.heading: Finish setup
complete.body: The wizard will lock. Further changes go through Settings.
complete.errorGeneric: Setup cannot be locked right now.

routing.title: Routing
routing.intro: WHEN origin OU + service THEN group. If there is no exact rule, the parent OU is used. If no route exists, the request stays UNROUTED.
routing.coverageEmpty: No service and OU combinations are available for coverage.
routing.coverageEmptyHint: Add a WHEN/THEN rule, or wait until the catalog and OU tree are ready.
routing.unroutedVisible: Routing gap — the request stays without a group.
routing.errorUnauthorized: Sign in is required to view routing.
routing.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to change routing.
routing.errorDuplicate: A rule already exists for this OU and service.

sla.title: SLA rules
sla.intro: BH calendars, SLA profiles, and rules by priority, service, and OU. Every change goes through the change log with a reason.
sla.rulesHint: Lower evaluation order is evaluated first. A more specific match (service/OU) wins on a tie.
sla.name: Name
sla.calendarsEmptyBody: Create a BH calendar with working hours and holidays.
sla.profilesEmptyBody: Add a calendar first, then an SLA profile and rules.
sla.rulesEmptyBody: Add first-response and resolution targets for this profile.
sla.changeLogEmptyBody: Successful administrative changes will appear here.
sla.errorUnauthorized: Sign in is required to view SLA configuration.
sla.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to change SLA configuration.
sla.errorDuplicate: A record with this key or match condition already exists.
sla.errorOverlap: Working intervals overlap or are invalid.
sla.errorInUse: The record is still in use and cannot be deleted.

integrationQueue.title: Integration queue
integrationQueue.intro: Durable integration queue. Browse PENDING/FAILED/DLQ jobs and retry failed or dead-lettered rows.
integrationQueue.heading: Integration jobs
integrationQueue.headingHint: Status comes from the backend. Retry moves FAILED/DLQ jobs back to PENDING and enqueues them immediately.
integrationQueue.forbiddenTitle: No access to the integration queue
integrationQueue.forbiddenBody: Queue inspection and retry are available to SuperAdmin and administrators with integrations.queue.manage.
integrationQueue.emptyBody: Switch the status filter or wait for the worker to record new attempts.
integrationQueue.errorUnauthorized: Sign in is required to view the integration queue.
integrationQueue.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to view or retry integration jobs.
integrationQueue.errorDisabled: The integration queue admin API is disabled.
integrationQueue.errorUnavailable: The integration queue is currently unavailable.
integrationQueue.errorInvalidStatus: Retry is allowed only for FAILED and DLQ jobs.
integrationQueue.errorNotFound: The integration job was not found.
integrationQueue.errorGeneric: The integration queue is currently unavailable.

configVersions.title: Config versions
configVersions.intro: Snapshots of settings, routing, SLA, and catalog. Dry-run validation, activation, and rollback with a required reason.
configVersions.forbiddenBody: Administrators can view versions. Create, validate, activate, and rollback require settings.write.
configVersions.readOnly: You can view versions but cannot change them.
configVersions.createHint: Captures the current live settings, routing, SLA, catalog, and forms.
configVersions.listHint: Select a version to validate, diff, activate, or roll back.
configVersions.emptyBody: Create the first config version to capture current state.
configVersions.validationOkBody: Dry-run reported no errors. You can activate this version.
configVersions.diffHint: Compare the selected version with another. The payload comes from GET :id/diff.
configVersions.diffUnchangedBody: The selected versions have the same snapshot.
configVersions.errorUnauthorized: Sign in is required to view config versions.
configVersions.errorForbidden: You do not have permission for this config version action.
configVersions.errorNotFound: The config version was not found.
configVersions.errorAlreadyActive: This config version is already active.
configVersions.errorNoPrevious: There is no previous version to restore.
configVersions.errorValidation: Config version validation failed. Review the error list.

knowledgeBase.title: Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.intro: Search and articles. Owner and review/stale status are visible on each article.
knowledgeBase.emptyHint: Create a draft article or check that you have permission to view published ones.
knowledgeBase.errorUnauthorized: Sign in is required to view the knowledge base.
knowledgeBase.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to change articles.
knowledgeBase.errorGeneric: The knowledge base is currently unavailable.

session.error: Sign in failed. Check the email and password.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.intro: Inbox, assigned work, and request creation. Before submitting a ticket, the system suggests knowledge base articles.
tickets.createSubtitle: Guided flow: service → details → knowledge check. The KB intercept step cannot be skipped.
tickets.createAfterRouting: The routing engine assigns a group from (OU + service)
tickets.createAfterSla: SLA timers start from the service profile
tickets.createAfterApproval: If the service needs approvals — the ticket waits for a decision
tickets.createAfterInbox: The group receives the ticket; an agent claims it or auto-assign runs
tickets.createAfterNotify: Participants see the ticket in the workspace
tickets.pickService: Choose a service from the catalog
tickets.pickServiceHint: Offered services only. Ticket creation stays possible during degraded availability.
tickets.calculatedPriority: Priority is calculated from the impact × urgency matrix
tickets.urgencyLabel: Urgency (how quickly it needs a fix)
tickets.emptyFilterHint: Widen the search or clear the priority filter.
tickets.emptyHint: Change filters or create a new ticket.
tickets.inboxHint: The group owns the ticket; an agent claims it or auto-assign runs. The unrouted queue has a separate owner.
tickets.unroutedBanner: There are unrouted items. UNROUTED is a coverage gap — claim them or complete routing.
tickets.originUnitHint: OU of the ticket source — used for routing, never the agent's OU.
tickets.priorityHint: Priority is calculated from impact and urgency.
tickets.availabilityUnavailable: This service is currently unavailable. Ticket creation stays possible.
tickets.noActiveForm: The selected service has no active form version.
tickets.noActiveFormHint: A ticket always stores a form version. Activate a form on the Services screen and try again.
tickets.interceptIntro: Review suggested articles before creating a ticket. Your form data is kept.
tickets.interceptEmpty: No articles for this service. You can continue and create a ticket.
tickets.helpedSkip: You marked an article as helpful. You can still create a ticket if needed.

detail.publicHint: visible to the requester · sends a notification
detail.internalHint: agents only · does not reset waiting-for-user
detail.composePublic: Reply to the requester… (Ctrl+Enter to send)
detail.attachHint: allow-list: pdf, png, jpg, log, docx, xlsx · max 25 MB
detail.waitingForUserHint: This ticket is waiting for the requester. A public user reply returns it to in progress. An internal note does not reset waiting.
detail.pendingApprovalHint: Approval is in progress. The SLA timer is paused until the approval chain completes.
detail.resolveHint: Required fields must be completed before {{status}}.
detail.participantDirectoryEmpty: No users available in the directory.
detail.noMessagesHint: Send the first public reply or an internal note.
detail.archivedHint: This ticket is archived and read-only. Data was not deleted.

csat.title: CSAT rating
csat.hint: Rate the ticket resolution (1 is lowest).

split.title: Split ticket
split.hint: Creates 2+ child tickets with a parent/child link. Messages and attachments transfer only when selected.

bulk.valuePlaceholder: Group, user, or parent ticket id
bulk.closeForbidden: Bulk close is not available (quality protection)
bulk.confirmRecipients: Recipient count is above the broadcast threshold. Click again to confirm.

tickets.errorUnauthorized: Sign in is required for tickets.
tickets.errorForbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
tickets.errorInvalidTransition: This status change is not allowed.
tickets.errorReopenRequired: Resolved or closed tickets reopen through the reopen action, not a status change.
tickets.errorBulkScope: Bulk actions apply only within the same OU and group.
tickets.errorConflict: This action conflicts with the current state.
tickets.errorRequiredFields: Required fields must be completed before resolve or close.
tickets.errorCloseCodeInvalid: That close code is not on the allow-list.
tickets.errorRedactionBlocked: This looks like a secret or personal data and was not saved.
tickets.errorDuplicateTicket: A similar ticket already exists. Confirm if you still need a new one.
tickets.errorBulkBroadcastConfirm: This broadcast is above the recipient threshold and needs extra confirmation.
tickets.errorConfidentialBreakGlass: This confidential ticket requires break-glass access with a reason.
tickets.errorCsatNotEligible: CSAT feedback is not available for this ticket.
tickets.errorCsatDuplicate: CSAT feedback was already submitted for this ticket.
tickets.errorFormVersionMissing: The selected service has no active form version, so the ticket cannot be created. Activate a form on the Services screen.

confidential.banner: Access is limited to the ACL list. Content is masked in logs and notifications. Emergency access is recorded through break-glass.
confidential.breakGlassHint: Content is hidden. Emergency access writes an audit trail (actor, time, reason, result) without confidential content.

tickets.redactionWarning: Possible secret or personal data was detected. The content was saved and the event was recorded.
tickets.errorCatalog: The service catalog is currently unavailable.
